verdict.rationale: Semgrep itself is a CLI/CI static-analysis tool with no native chat or NL command interface, but there is a documented official MCP server (docs.semgrep.dev/mcp) that would let an AI agent invoke Semgrep functions via natural language, and semgrep-gh-3 mentions an AI 'Assistant' for noise reduction. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the MCP server exposes, evidence of actual natural-language command usage/hands-on examples, and independent corroboration that AI agents can drive full Semgrep workflows conversationally.
